name: pump-boluses
description: Six hours on a 0.85 U/hr profile with boluses from the pump's own screen only, as on a pump used without an app: 4.5 U 320 minutes ago, a 1.0 U correction 180 minutes ago, 5.0 U 75 minutes ago and a 0.8 U correction 15 minutes ago, the last bolus. No temp rate or suspend. With Control-IQ off the pump shows about 4.9 U IOB, none of it from an app.
